ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the figure is a cobalt complex transition-state structure. After ignoring all curved arrows, it can be seen that two Co atoms are connected by a Co–Co bond; the left Co also forms a small ring with the alkene carbon in the organic fragment and bears carbonyl ligands; the right Co is labeled as Co(CO)3, and the figure also has another CO ligand labeled above. The left end of the organic fragment is an R1-substituted alkene carbon, and the right end is connected to a tertiary carbon center bearing OR2, R3, and R4. Reasoning: represent unspecified substituents such as R1, R2, R3, R4 with wildcard *; the tertiary center can be written as *OC(*)(*)C...; the alkene-cobalt three-membered ring is represented with ring numbering as C1=C(*)[Co]1; then add three C#[O+] carbonyl ligands to the first Co, connect the second [Co], and add four C#[O+] carbonyl ligands to the second Co, giving the target SMILES.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a graph, excluding only the reaction arrows: identify the organic fragment as *O-C(*)(*)-C(=C(*)-[Co])- embedded in a cobalt metallocycle, with the second alkene carbon bonded to R1 as '*'. Encode the tertiary substituent center bearing OR2, R3, and R4 as *OC(*)(*)C... . Then encode the C=C-to-Co ring by assigning a ring digit between the carbon and cobalt, giving C1=C(*)[Co]1. Add the ligands read from the image: three C#[O+] groups on this cobalt, a Co-Co bond to the second [Co], and four carbonyl ligands total on/through the second cobalt as depicted by the three (CO) labels plus the extra CO, yielding the final SMILES connectivity matching *OC(*)(*)C1=C(*)[Co]1(C#[O+])(C#[O+])(C#[O+])[Co](C#[O+])(C#[O+])(C#[O+])C#[O+].
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个钴配合物过渡态结构，忽略所有弯箭头后，可见两个 Co 原子以 Co–Co 键相连；左侧 Co 还与有机片段中的烯烃碳形成小环，并带有羰基配体；右侧 Co 标注为 Co(CO)3，图中另有一个 CO 配体标注在上方。有机片段左端是 R1 取代的烯烃碳，右端连接到一个带 OR2、R3、R4 的三级碳中心。推理：将 R1、R2、R3、R4 等未指定取代基用通配符 * 表示，三级中心可写为 *OC(*)(*)C...；烯烃-钴三元环用环编号表示为 C1=C(*)[Co]1；再给第一个 Co 加三个 C#[O+] 羰基配体、连接第二个 [Co]，并给第二个 Co 加四个 C#[O+] 羰基配体，得到目标 SMILES。

method.CoT_qualify_0: 总体可通过：候选 trace 先描述图像、再进行 SMILES 推理，符合“先描述图像，再推理”的要求；其通配符替换、三级碳片段 *OC(*)(*)C...、C=C–Co 小环 C1=C(*)[Co]1、Co–Co 键以及 3+4 个羰基配体的编码均与标准答案的连通性基本一致。建议修订时明确写出最终 SMILES：*OC(*)(*)C1=C(*)[Co]1(C#[O+])(C#[O+])(C#[O+])[Co](C#[O+])(C#[O+])(C#[O+])C#[O+]。另外，“左侧 Co 形成小环”的表述略有视觉方位歧义，最好改为“与烯烃两个碳成环的那个 Co”，并说明另一个 Co 带有三个 CO 加上图中额外的 CO。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the natural single-route solution: directly transcribe the displayed transition-state connectivity into a molecular graph, treating substituent labels as wildcard atoms and omitting only curved arrows. It relies on atom-by-atom graph extraction rather than comparing choices or using reaction context.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the chemical drawing: two cobalt centers are bonded; each cobalt bears three CO ligands, and an additional CO ligand is drawn above the left cobalt/Co region. The left cobalt is also part of a three-membered metallocycle with a C=C unit: one alkene carbon bears R1, the other is attached to a tertiary carbon bearing OR2, R3, and R4. Ignore all curved arrows but preserve the atoms and bonds in the drawn transition-state framework.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to know the required output is a SMILES expression for the shown transition-state structure and that arrows must be ignored rather than interpreted as bonds or transformations.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions for organometallic/complex notation: represent generic R groups as wildcard atoms '*'; encode carbonyl ligands as C#[O+]; place cobalt as [Co]; use ring-closure digits for the cobalt-containing three-membered ring; and choose any valid traversal that preserves the same graph connectivity.
